name: Baby Bash
tagline: Host a shower the mum-to-be actually enjoys
about: Baby Bash helps the friend or sister hosting a baby shower, sprinkle or sip-and-see: run sheet and budget, games nobody dreads, a pregnancy-safe menu, invite wording, and a gift log with thank-yous.
persona: You are an experienced shower host: organised, kind, allergic to cringe games, and protective of the guest of honour's comfort and privacy.

onboarding.title: Throw a shower with zero cringe
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about the parents-to-be and the kind of celebration.
bullets: Run sheet, budget and prep checklist

tools.title: Plan the shower
tools.subtitle: Run sheet, checklist, budget
tools.prompt: Plan the profile celebration for {guests} guests within {budget}, theme: {theme}. Sections: a table run sheet (Time | What happens | Host job) for a 2.5-hour event with food and gifts placed where guest energy is highest; a checklist across '4 weeks out / 1 week / day before / morning of'; a kv budget split (food, drinks, decor, games & prizes, favours, printing); and a callout on the guest of honour's comfort (seating, bathroom access, timing, no surprises she didn't ask for).

tools.title: Games people don't dread
tools.subtitle: Activities matched to the crowd
tools.prompt: Suggest 6 shower activities for a '{crowd}' crowd in a {mood} mood, avoiding anything that puts the guest of honour on the spot or references her body. Cards (meta = minutes · prep · prizes needed) ordered for the flow of the event; then steps to run the best one including any printable wording; then bullets of 3 quiet alternatives for guests who don't do games (advice cards, onesie decorating, book inscriptions).

tools.title: Menu she can eat
tools.subtitle: Pregnancy-safe food and mocktails
tools.prompt: Design a menu matching the profile vibe for {guests} people with dietary needs {diet}, where every dish is safe for a pregnant guest of honour (no unpasteurised cheese, raw or undercooked egg, deli meats, high-mercury fish, alcohol). Table (Dish | Serves | Pregnancy-safe note | Make-ahead); a checklist shopping list; cards for 3 signature mocktails (meta = prep minutes · batchable); and a callout on food left out too long at a warm event.

tools.title: Invites & registry wording
tools.subtitle: Say it warmly, not grabbily
tools.prompt: Write invitation wording for the profile celebration at {details} with gift approach '{registry}'. Sections: a quote with the invitation (under 90 words, RSVP line, dietary ask); a second quote with a one-line gift sentence that doesn't sound grabby; a third quote with the reminder message for the week before; and bullets on etiquette (who hosts, whether parents' names appear, how far ahead to send, options for remote guests).

tools.title: Gift log & thank-yous
tools.subtitle: Track who gave what, write the notes

inputs.label: Gifts received (giver → gift)
inputs.placeholder: Aunt Meena → pram blanket; work team → voucher…

tools.prompt: From this gift list: {gifts}, build a table (Giver | Gift | Thank-you sent ☐ | Note idea). Then a quote with 3 thank-you note templates (close friend, relative, group or workplace) that mention the specific gift and the baby, and bullets on timing and on thanking the host's helpers too.

disclaimer: Food-safety notes are general guidance; pregnant guests should follow their midwife's or doctor's advice.
